prime_award_base_transaction_description: IGF::OT::IGF THIS IS A 38-MONTH CONTRACT IN SUPPORT OF THE HUSKY MOUNTED DETECTION SYSTEM (HMDS) PROGRAM OF RECORD (POR).  THIS CONTRACT INCLUDES A 23-MONTH ENGINEERING AND MANUFACTURING DEVELOPMENT (EMD) BASE PERIOD WITH A 15-MONTH LOW RATE INITIAL PRODUCTION (LRIP) OPTION.  THE HMDS IS A COUNTER-IED SYSTEM WITH THE CAPABILITIES TO DETECT UNDERBELLY IEDS AND ANTITANK LANDMINES BURIED IN PRIMARY AND SECONDARY ROADS. AS A RESULT, THE HMDS IS VITAL TO ROUTE CLEARANCE PACKAGES (RCP).  HMDS USES AN ADVANCED, HIGH-PERFORMANCE GROUND PENETRATING RADAR (GPR) TO DETECT BOTH NON-METALLIC AND METAL-CASED BURIED THREATS, INCLUDING IEDS CONSTRUCTED OF BULK EXPLOSIVES AND LOW-METAL PRESSURE PLATES.  THIS PROPOSED CONTRACT IS REFERRED TO AS THE HMDS INCREMENT A, CONFIGURATION 2, HENCEFORTH KNOWN AS, HMDS-A2.  HMDS-A2 PROVIDES THE GPR, DEEP BURIED DETECTION (DBD), AND MARKING CAPABILITIES, INSTALLED ON THE MANNED AND UNMANNED MARK III HUSKY, THAT ENABLE DETECTION OF UNDERBELLY-ATTACK EXPLOSIVE HAZARDS DURING ROUTE CLEARANCE MISSIONS AND WEAPONS CACHES DURING AREA CLEARANCE MISSIONS.
